meaning: Check source-owned Workflow orchestration structure in TypeScript and strict-emitted ESM, independently of generated text and finite-case availability.
binding: Require branded graph and plan with equal certificates and pinned binding, outcome and audit definitions. Rebuild exact forward Operation imports and ordered occurrence identities. Expected failure-prefix templates come from the independent outcome reference, never the production Workflow renderer or recovery planner.
execution: Match the complete async execute protocol: inert identity and input capture before suspension; exact forward callable, action/descriptor pin and dependency capture; exactly one source-ordered occurrence block with typed argument preparation, awaited bound Operation, returned settlement observation, terminal stop before committed result capture, and final result materialization only after every occurrence. Separate not-started, thrown uncertainty, committed-result-invalid and result-materialization-failed boundaries. Additional, unreachable, duplicated or reordered statements do not satisfy the protocol.
recovery: Check complete typed compensation preparation without execution, exact source-derived frozen Workflow and selected-policy metadata and every independent failure-prefix plan. Check the committed-only prefix expression and indeterminate-return boundary before intent construction. These structural checks complement independent finite metadata and effect observations; they are not a full semantic proof of every support helper.
syntax: Use compiler AST structure, not substring or whitespace matching. Erase only source type annotations/assertions, non-null assertions and parentheses. Preserve runtime operators, optional chaining, spread, binding mutability, arity, parameter defaults, async/await, export identity and statement order. Unknown runtime syntax in an exact protocol region fails closed.
scope: One profile row per selected Workflow provider, including Workflows unavailable to the finite verifier. Exact runtime imports: one metadata createHash, one material namespace and the sorted unique forward Operations; no compensation-only imports. All forward calls and awaits must belong to the exact execute protocol. Declaration shadowing and extra runtime exports cannot replace checked bindings.
custody: Emit phase, definition pin, exact provider byte hashes and violations. Public source-to-native compilation, observer/input/output/module custody and final currentness remain separate prerequisites; this private observer cannot certify a caller-forged profile or claim public coverage.
verification: Require clean source/native pairs, ordered and unconstrained recovery, multiple and repeated Operation bindings, absent compensations, erased syntax acceptance, strict-compiling order/argument/dependency/await/stop/capture/metadata/import mutations and native-only drift.
compatibility: Preserve predecessor definitions, production semantics, source capsule and public not_evaluable status until verified public integration. No automatic compensation execution, admission, installation or publication.
claim_ceiling: Private bounded structural evidence; not universal behavioral equivalence, production durability, public Workflow coverage or CLI completion.
